title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Middle-schooler Madoka Kaname is offered a contract by the cat-like Kyubey: one wish granted in exchange for becoming a magical girl who fights witches. The mysterious transfer student Homura tries to stop her, and Madoka watches friends who accepted the deal suffer and die. This three-volume adaptation of the 2011 anime reveals the dark cost behind the contracts, Homura's repeated time loops, and Madoka's final self-sacrificing wish.
life_message: Love that gives itself up for others, even everything one has, can overcome a system built on despair.
